verdict.rationale: The project claims parallel crawling as a core performance feature and supports batches of URLs with per-pattern strategies. A real-time dashboard shows browser pool visibility, which implies pooled concurrent browsers, and remote CDP browser control is pitched for large-scale extraction. A Dockerized FastAPI server, session reuse and retries with proxy fallback support running this at scale. Missing for 10: concrete documentation of the concurrent-crawl API and its concurrency, rate-limiting or memory controls; independent or hands-on corroboration of throughput at scale.
